messages.content: I'll run a SPARQL query that compares the birth dates of the directors of the two films and returns the film whose director has the later birth date (i.e., is younger). I'll execute the query on DBpedia.

messages.name: execute

args.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?film ?filmLabel ?director ?directorBirth WHERE {
  VALUES ?film { dbr:Return_of_the_Hero dbr:Home_in_Indiana }
  ?film dbo:director ?director .
  ?director dbo:birthDate ?directorBirth .

  # Bind the other film and its director birth date
  VALUES ?otherFilm { dbr:Return_of_the_Hero dbr:Home_in_Indiana }
  FILTER (?otherFilm != ?film)
  ?otherFilm dbo:director ?otherDirector .
  ?otherDirector dbo:birthDate ?otherDirectorBirth .

  # Keep only the film whose director is younger (later birth date)
  FILTER (?directorBirth > ?otherDirectorBirth)

  OPTIONAL { ?film rdfs:label ?filmLabel . FILTER (lang(?filmLabel) = "en") }
}
LIMIT 10

args.sparql:
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?film ?filmLabel ?director ?directorBirth WHERE {
  VALUES ?film { dbr:Return_of_the_Hero dbr:Home_in_Indiana }
  ?film dbo:director ?director .
  ?director dbo:birthDate ?directorBirth .

  # Bind the other film and its director birth date
  VALUES ?otherFilm { dbr:Return_of_the_Hero dbr:Home_in_Indiana }
  FILTER (?otherFilm != ?film)
  ?otherFilm dbo:director ?otherDirector .
  ?otherDirector dbo:birthDate ?otherDirectorBirth .

  # Keep only the film whose director is younger (later birth date)
  FILTER (?directorBirth > ?otherDirectorBirth)

  OPTIONAL { ?film rdfs:label ?filmLabel . FILTER (lang(?filmLabel) = "en") }
}
LIMIT 10
